content: Serialization based on the network representation If a net- work representation that defines a SwBaseType and optionally a CompuMethod is provided for each DataPrototype typed by a primitive data type that is part of the serialized ISignal ( ISignal . transformationISignalProps . dataPrototype- TransformationProps . networkRepresentationProps ), these SwBaseType s shall be used for the serialization/deserialization.
